full_judgment: 6. It appears from plaint that defendant No. 2 sold the suit land measuring 2.24 acres to the plaintiffs by kabalas dated 25.5.75 and 28.5.76. It has further been alleged in the plaint that defendant No. 1 created kabala dated 7.10.74 in respect of the suit land by false personification of defendant No. 2. It further appears from the written statement filed by defendant No. 1 that he claimed 1.66 acres of the suit land on the basis of the kabala dated 7.10.74 from the defendant No. 2. It is thus clear from the averments of the pleadings of both the parties that proforma defendant No. 2 Indu Bhuson had no subsisting interest in the suit land. No relief was sought against the said defendant No. 2 by the plaintiffs. So Court below was not justified in dismissing the entire suit for taking no step for service of fresh summons upon the defendant No. 2. Trial Court could at best dismiss the suit as against proforma defendant No. 2 only. This aspect of the case was not all considered by the trial Court while passing the impugned order dated 14.9.81 dismissing plaintiffs' Miscellaneous Case No. 98 of 1979. It is true that plaintiffs filed the said miscellaneous case long after 2-1/2 years. Plaintiffs, therefore, filed an application under section 5 of the Limitation Act for condoning the delay in filing the said miscellaneous case explaining the grounds of delay. Their main contention was that their relation Tofazzal Hossain who was their tadbirker being gained over by the defendant, he allowed the suit to be dismissed for default without taking steps and thus they were prevented from knowing about the said dismissal order till 15.9.79, three days before filing of the case when they came to learn about the same on enquiry through Advocate's clerk. This assertion of the plaintiffs did not find favour with the learned trial Court on the ground of non-examination of the said Tofazzal Hossain. How could the learned subordinate judge take such adverse presumption against the plaintiffs for non-examination of Tofazzal Hossain when their allegation is against him. This shows complete lack of judicial experience on the part of the learned Subordinate Judge. Court will take adverse presumption for non-production of any evidence or non-examination of any witness if the party is in a position to produce such evidence or witness before the Court. But if a party can explain that he is not in a position to produce the witness being hostile to him no Court can take an adverse presumption for non-examination of such witness. So the judgment of the learned Subordinate Judge is a perverse one and liable to be set aside.
